payload._note: Addus HomeCare Corporation operates approximately 219 offices across 22 states as of December 31, 2023, providing personal care, hospice, and home health services. The 10-K does not provide a detailed facility roster with individual facility names, addresses, cities, or CMS Certification Numbers (CCNs). The filing describes operations by state and segment (personal care, hospice, home health) with revenue concentrations in Illinois (51.7% of personal care segment), New York (11.6%), and New Mexico (14.6%). The company serves approximately 91,000 discrete consumers annually. Major acquisitions in 2023 included Tennessee Quality Care (home health and hospice in Tennessee) and CareStaff (personal care in Florida). The filing references 'approximately 219 offices' but does not enumerate specific facilities, facility types, or provide CCNs that would enable direct Medicare Provider of Services (POS) file matching. To obtain facility-level CCNs, a subsequent lookup in Medicare POS files using the company name 'Addus' or subsidiary names across the 22 operating states would be required.
